en:
(I should see if the
locals have any leads.)

Hi there.
Is your bar open yet?

Oh, I'm still prepping things for the day.
Wait, you've got a baby!?

So cute! He's what, a year old?
A boy, right?
Yeah. Right, Haruto?
Oh, you only like your papa, huh?
Actually, I'm not his father.
Oh, your grandson, perhaps?
Grandson...?
Right, I can see how you'd think that.

Anyway, if you're about to open,
would you mind if I come in for a drink?

Not at all. I still have a few things to
get ready, but, after you.
Huh? Kiyo-chan, who's yer friend here?

He's a customer. You should head home
soon, Nagumo-kun. I'm about to open.

Please, have a seat. Oh, right! I should
fix up a special spot for the baby.

You, tough guy. Where y'from?
Y'don't look local.
I'm from Tokyo.
Tokyo, huh? I get ya, I get ya.

But tell me, what's a Tokyo fella like you
doin' here? Y'don't look like no tourist.

Sir, you can lay the baby in here
if you want. It's the perfect size for him.

So? You like it?
You're a cute little guy.
Thanks for this, Mama.

It's fine. This is the first time I've
had such an adorable little customer.
All I usually get around here are punks.

Why ya gotta do me like that?
Shouldn't y'be more respectful t'yer regulars?

Nagumo-kun, put that cigarette out.
It's not good for the baby.
Besides, don't you have work to do?

My work's here in yer bar. Keepin' an eye
on this fishy bastard is my job today.

So, Tokyo man.
Y'got a name?

It's Kiryu.
I won't be any trouble here.

Shut it, fool. 'Round here, I decide who's
trouble and who ain't. Y'get me!?

That's enough out of you! Go on, scram!
You don't get to choose who my customers are.
Keep the change.

I don't like the cut of yer jib. Y'can't play
the tough guy 'gainst a yakuza like me.

Yer just usin' that little brat of yers
to hit on my Kiyo-chan, ain'tchya?
Who are you calling yours?
What're y'lookin' at, asshole?

Getting drunk and fighting with civilians?
Some yakuza you are.
The hell you say!?

Let's take this outside. It's hard to talk to this
pretty Mama with you yapping in my ear.
Sir, should I call the police?

It's all right. He'll calm down once I sober
him up a bit. Can you keep an eye on Haruto?

Alright, let's do this! I'll show ya
how we <font_kind=yakuza_italic>take care</font_kind> of guys like you.
By tearin' ya to bits!

This here's perfect.
Nobody to go gettin' in the way.
Too late t'go cryin' fer help now.

Remember, this is what ya get fer pissin' me off.
Dieeeeeee!

What the hell?
H-How'd I lose to you...?
Had enough?

I don't get it.
Who are ya!?

Don't see why you're so surprised.
A child could've floored a drunk fool like you.
Don't you walk away!

I'm captain of the Hirose Family! Next time
we meet, I ain't lettin' ya off so easy!
Jus' scurry on back to Tokyo already, y'hear!?

(Looks like I'm already making friends here.
Anyway, I should get back to Haruto...)

Oh, you're back.
Is everything okay?

Yeah. I see you've been
taking good care of Haruto.
Yeah, he just fell asleep.
He really is a cute kid.

Oh, right.
How about a drink?
So, this is Haruto-kun's mom?
She looks young.

She's 19 now. She left her home in Okinawa
three years ago and apparently came here.
To this neighborhood?

Take a good look at that photo.
Did you ever see her around town?
You came here to find her, Kiryu-san?
No, I already know where she is.

What I need now is more information.
Who she met here, what she was doing.
Can't you ask her that directly?
Well, not exactly.
I'm actually hoping I can find Haruto's dad.

I have a hunch he's around here somewhere,
but that's about all I have to go on.

I'm sorry. I would help you if I could,
but I don't think I recognize this girl.

She was a famous idol before she came here.
Have you ever heard of Haruka Sawamura?

I haven't.
I almost never watch TV.

Thanks for the drink.
What do I owe you?
It's on me this time.

I got to hold the cutest little baby, and you
had your evening ruined by one of my regulars.
You mean that yakuza?

By the way, Kiryu-san...
Where are you staying?

Well, I'm not sure yet.
I was about to go look.

There won't be anywhere open
at this time of day, though.
There are some hotels outside of town.

But you're here in Onomichi to look
for Haruto-kun's dad, aren't you?
Staying out there might be inconvenient.

I've got it. Give me just a second,
I know a guy who might have a room for you.
It's nothing too luxurious, but...

If you don't like it, I can help you look
for a hotel farther away.

Hello? It's Kiyomi. Good evening.
Sorry to call so late, Ino-kun.

Would it be okay if one of my customers
stays at the Navy Apartments for a while?

That was Ino-kun from the local association.
He owns the room I mentioned earlier.

It's been empty for quite a while, so he
said it'd be okay for you to stay there.

You've been a huge help.
Thank you.

Don't get your hopes up, though.
He hasn't kept it very clean with nobody there.
He said he'd leave a futon out, though.

Come back for a drink sometime if you're
up for it. I'd love to see Haruto-kun again.

You've been very kind.
I appreciate it.

The apartments are just down the
coastline and west from there.

Got it. Next time I drop in,
I'll actually buy my drinks.
Hey, you. Kiryu-san?
Kiyo-chan called me.

Y'know, the mama from Snack Kiyomi.
Yer the fella who needs my apartment, huh?

Oh, yeah.
I'm Kiryu, and this is Haruto.
Name's Ino.

So, what'd y'say to get
Kiyo-chan to like ya, huh?
I don't follow?

Just move it along.
Apartment's this way.
Listen, if I'm not welcome, say so.

Woulda said no if it weren't my
Kiyo-chan doin' the askin'.

I got no say in it though. If the light
of my life calls, I pick up the phone.

You too? A yakuza I met earlier said
she was "his" as well.
Nagumo, huh?
Yeah, I think that's the guy.
Three of us went t'high school together.

Nagumo and me fought
tooth n' nail over Kiyo-chan.

She got sick of our shit, though.
Ended up runnin' off to Tokyo alone.
So she used to live in Tokyo...

With her movin' back here though,
it's like the fire never died.

But man, it's kinda different with that
nutsack Nagumo bein' a yakuza now.

Back in the good ol' days
I could knock him on his ass, y'know?

But now that he's stronger,
he acts like he owns the place.

Now listen good. Don't go lettin' Kiyo-chan's
kindness get to yer head, y'hear?

I'll kick ya out so fast yer head'll spin if
ya get any funny ideas. Remember that.
Well, this here's your room.
Y'can leave whenever if yer not happy.
No, I appreciate this, Ino-san.

There's a futon for ya, but y'can handle the
rest. It's gettin' torn down soon anyways.
The Navy Apartments're on their last legs.
Why "navy"?
Town's been buildin' ships fer ages.
Used to be full o' sea-farin' types.

Then some so-called "navy" showed up,
and used these buildings as a base.
But they weren't no real navy at all.

They was probly tryin' to swindle the sailors.
Y'know, a buncha thugs tryin' t'look legit.

Some time later, the navy got took in by
a yakuza group called the Yomei Alliance.

That's the yakuza that plumb fool
Nagumo's got his'self involved with.

He tries n' claim he's some hotshot Hirose
captain, but it's small time. Five, six guys, tops.
I'm not surprised.

As for Kiyo-chan, her bar's in a former
red-light district for the Yomei Alliance.

But things changed once shipbuildin' slowed
down. The good times're never comin' back.
So, you from Tokyo?

I dunno what brings ya down here,
but this ain't a place outsiders stay fer long.

I can tell. I'll be gone as soon as I'm done here.
Until then, I appreciate the room.
Save yer thanks for Kiyo-chan.

All right, it looks like this is
where we'll be living for a while.

(I should buy some milk.
Hopefully it won't be too hard to find...)

(Things seem to close early here.
But someone's got to carry milk, right?)
Man, I'm sauced as a spring turkey.
Just wanna hit the sack...
Huh? Don't reckon I've seen ya 'round afore.

You know any places that might
sell powdered milk around here?
I'm all out, and the kid's starving.
Hm? That little guy yer son?

Nowhere's gonna be open right now.
Y'oughta just put him to bed fer tonight.

Do you know any places that might
sell powdered milk around here?

Ummm, powdered milk?
Sorry, I don't have the slightest idea.
I only just moved to the area.

If only there were
convenience stores here...

Do you know anywhere that might
sell powdered milk near here?

Lemme see, coulda sworn I saw
it at some place I was...

Whereabouts, though...? Only caught
my eye as I was buyin' somethin' else.
Sorry, my memory's shot.

But I bet they probly sell it
somewhere 'round here.
Hm? C'mon with that, old guy.

I'm all out, and the kid's starving.
I could really use a bit of help.

An ol' grump like you's raisin' a baby?
Now I seen it all!

Yer woman walk out on ya
or somethin'? Rough life, gramps.

I take it you don't know, then!
Bye.
Well, good luck!

S'gonna be fine. I'll grab a bus
over t'yours this weekend.

Chi-chan, y'ain't been messin'
with other guys, have ya? Just kiddin'!

Can't wait to see ya again, babe.
Love ya too.

Hm? Yeah, hold on a sec.
What is it, old man? Y'need somethin'?
Uh, Chi-chan, y'still there?

I got a mean-lookin' grandpa with
a kid standin' in front of me.

Wanted to know if I know
anyplace that's got milk.

You know one, Chi-chan!?
Yeah. Mhm.

Chi-chan says try goin' to the pharmacy.
S'posedly they got yer milk there.

Right, good idea.
Thanks for the help.

Nice, Chi-chan!
Yer the best!

(The pharmacy is closed too...
But this can't wait until morning!)

Excuse me!
Is anyone in there?

Open up, please!
I need milk for a baby!

Don't y'know how late it is?
The store's been closed fer hours!

Sorry, I just need a little milk. Can you
sell me some? The kid won't stop crying.

Yer gonna have to come back tomorrow.
We're all out.

That won't work. Are there any
other stores that might sell it?

'Round here...?
I reckon no.

This is bad...
What am I supposed to do?
Anyway, where're y'comin' from?

Sorry, ma'am.
There's no time for small talk.

I just need some milk. Even formula
would work. You don't know anywhere?

Now that y'mention it, Ino might
be able to get what yer lookin' for.

Ino? The association guy?
The one who runs the Navy Apartments?

Y'know him? I bet that go-getter
can help ya out. He's a real peach.
You know where he is by chance?
Haven't the foggiest.

(Wait, Kiyomi knows his number.
I should go to the bar and ask her.)

Hm? Kiryu-san!
How does Ino-kun's apartment look?

Oh, it's not so bad. Can I ask you
to contact him for me, though?

Haruto's been bawling his eyes out for
a while now. I need to get some milk.

Oh, of course.
Just give me a minute.

Thank you.
I'll wait outside.

Shouldn't be much longer.
Sorry for the wait, Haruto.
Kiryu-san. Ino-kun had some info for me.

He said a barber in town had a baby recently.
They might share their milk with you.

A barber?
Is the shop nearby?

Yeah. I wish I could show you the way,
but I need to tend the bar.

It's all right. Thank you, though.
I'll go take a look around.
(Is this the barber shop Kiyomi mentioned?)
Excuse me! Is anyone there?

Uh, I'm having a bit of trouble
with my baby here.

Whaddya think yer doin'!?
This is a public street!

Oh yeah? And who's gonna stop me,
ya ol' witch? Simmer down, now.

Hey, we're talking over here.
Do your business elsewhere!

If I've gotta piss, I'm gonna piss!
Quit yer yappin'!

Y'can't do that on someone's house!
We got rules fer a reason, y'know!

Words aren't doing the job here.
Sorry, but hold this kid for a sec.
Wh-What? Wait!

Look, you need to leave.
You're interrupting our conversation.

What's yer deal, gramps?
Y'wanna go?
Enough. I told you to get out of here.

So yer spoilin' fer a fight, huh?
Yer in luck, gramps, 'cause I'll fuck ya up!

Hey, whaddya think yer doin'?
Y'can't make such a ruckus this time o' night.
Sorry about that.

I heard the owners here had a baby, so I
was just hoping for some milk for my kid.

Okay, if that's all y'want.
I'll go grab some fer ya.
The shops 'round here all close real early.

Y'gotta make sure ya got your milk
'fore the sun goes down.

Yeah, I just learned that firsthand.
Thank you, though. You're a real lifesaver.

Jus' get home n' feed him already.
Y'don't wanna let him keep bawlin' like that.
Rough night, huh, Kiryu-san?

Wait, did you come by because
you were worried about me?

Mhm. I can't ignore the helpless, I guess.
Sorry if I'm intruding.
